# ADR NNNN. Short imperative title

**Status.** Proposed, accepted, or superseded by ADR NNNN.

**Date.** YYYY-MM-DD.

**Deciders.** Names.

## Context

What forced a decision. The constraints that were real at the time, including the ones that turned out to matter most. Enough that a reader who was not there understands why this was not obvious.

## Decision

What was chosen, stated plainly enough that a reader can tell whether a later change violates it.

## Alternatives considered

One subsection per option that was genuinely on the table. Each says what it offered and the specific reason it lost. An alternative listed without a reason is worse than omitting it, because it implies the choice was arbitrary.

### Alternative name

What it offered. Why it lost.

## Consequences

What this makes easy, what it makes hard, and what it forecloses. Name the cost honestly; a decision recorded with only upsides reads as advocacy and gets ignored.

## Revisit when

The specific condition that would justify reopening this. A decision with no revisit condition is either genuinely permanent, which is rare, or it has not been thought through.
